answer: Anchor each agent identity to a 500-token stake locked for 90 days before it can vote or earn, so a fake identity costs real capital, not a free keypair. A bridge check requires proof of completed, verifiable work before rewards flow, leaving idle clones powerless. Monitoring flags clusters above a 70% similarity threshold in funding source, device fingerprint and task timing; confirmed farms lose 50% of every stake, the rest burned. One ring of 200 marble-identical copies was caught this way, turning a cheap attack into a 50,000-token loss.
